rate_offered.notes: Nominal annual rate before tax printed '0.10% (פריים - 4.65%)'. Row 'פיקדון חודשי (30 יום)', rate type 'משתנה', linkage 'לא צמוד', amount '1,000 עד 500,000 ש"ח', break 'אין אפשרות לשבירה', automatic renewal 'קיימת', number of renewals 'עד 17 (ולא יותר מ-540 יום)', exit points 'לא קיימת'. This row as printed: '1,000 עד 500,000 ש"ח': '0.10% (פריים - 4.65%)'. Read 2026-11-14 on p.6 of the file the bank's deposits page links (https://www.bank-yahav.co.il/investments/deposits/), re-issued on 10.11.2026, headed 'בתוקף מיום: 11/11/2026' with '10/11/2026 11_26' under the date (library eeb6aefc72e67b13); every figure this record takes from p.6 is as it was. The common-deposit column is empty on every row.

tax_bucket.notes: Unlinked shekel deposit: interest taxed at 15% of the nominal interest (TXI-03); 'linked' means CPI or exchange rate, so an unlinked or prime-linked shekel deposit is in this bucket (TXI-04); the bank withholds 15% (TXI-08). Copied from the rule base (TXI-03's source, read 2026-10-25), not re-read today.

The account agreement (s.6.1.1, p.36) says that if the bank allows an early withdrawal 'לפנים משורת הדין', the money withdrawn bears no interest or linkage and the bank may charge 'בסכום השווה לנזק שיגרם לבנק' (BANK-33, BANK-48).
